# Each type alone as a function's result, and the unary operators over every type.
top: k = 2;

template: $0
int => int -- sec:type_resolution "each value keeps its own carrier"
rat => rat -- sec:type_resolution "each value keeps its own carrier"
f32 => f32 -- sec:type_resolution "each value keeps its own carrier"
f64 => f64 -- sec:type_resolution "each value keeps its own carrier"
f16 => f16 !! L1.18a: notyet -- sec:type_resolution "each value keeps its own carrier"
bool => bool -- sec:type_resolution "each value keeps its own carrier"
Utf8String => Utf8String !! STR-types: notyet -- sec:type_resolution "each value keeps its own carrier"
(int, f64) => (int, f64) -- sec:type_resolution "each value keeps its own carrier"
int | #none => int | #none -- sec:type_resolution "each value keeps its own carrier"
f64 | #none => f64 | #none -- sec:type_resolution "each value keeps its own carrier"
=#none => #none -- L1.26b "f(x) = (x, 1) is (x: T) -> (T, 1)" (a literal returned keeps its value); sec:diagnostics "-3 for -3r" (a signed literal is a literal)
=2 => 2 -- L1.26b "f(x) = (x, 1) is (x: T) -> (T, 1)" (a literal returned keeps its value); sec:diagnostics "-3 for -3r" (a signed literal is a literal)
=2.5 => 2.5 -- L1.26b "f(x) = (x, 1) is (x: T) -> (T, 1)" (a literal returned keeps its value); sec:diagnostics "-3 for -3r" (a signed literal is a literal)
=2.5f64 => f64 !! LIT-forced-carrier: 2.5 -- sec:type_resolution "each value keeps its own carrier"
=2r => rat !! LIT-forced-carrier: 2r -- sec:type_resolution "each value keeps its own carrier"
=k => 2 -- L1.26b "f(x) = (x, 1) is (x: T) -> (T, 1)" (a literal returned keeps its value); sec:diagnostics "-3 for -3r" (a signed literal is a literal)

template: -$0
int => int -- sec:lexical "+ - * arithmetic on numbers"; sec:domains "three() = 1 + 2 is () -> int"
rat => rat -- sec:lexical "+ - * arithmetic on numbers"; sec:domains "three() = 1 + 2 is () -> int"
f32 => f32 -- sec:lexical "+ - * arithmetic on numbers"; sec:domains "three() = 1 + 2 is () -> int"
f64 => f64 -- sec:lexical "+ - * arithmetic on numbers"; sec:domains "three() = 1 + 2 is () -> int"
f16 => f16 !! L1.18a: notyet -- sec:lexical "+ - * arithmetic on numbers"; sec:domains "three() = 1 + 2 is () -> int"
bool => error * -- sec:lexical "+ - * arithmetic on numbers"; sec:domains "three() = 1 + 2 is () -> int"
Utf8String => error * !! STR-types: notyet -- sec:lexical "+ - * arithmetic on numbers"; sec:domains "three() = 1 + 2 is () -> int"
(int, f64) => error * -- sec:lexical "+ - * arithmetic on numbers"; sec:linalg "Arithmetic on morphisms" (of one exact domain)
int | #none => int | #none -- sec:lexical "+ - * arithmetic on numbers"; sec:domains "three() = 1 + 2 is () -> int"; sec:failure "an atom an operand carries in passes through"; author decision "loose atoms bubble when the rest matches"
f64 | #none => f64 | #none -- sec:lexical "+ - * arithmetic on numbers"; sec:domains "three() = 1 + 2 is () -> int"; sec:failure "an atom an operand carries in passes through"; author decision "loose atoms bubble when the rest matches"
=#none => #none -- sec:failure "an atom an operand carries in passes through"; author decision "loose atoms bubble when the rest matches"
=2 => -2 -- L1.26b "f(x) = (x, 1) is (x: T) -> (T, 1)" (a literal returned keeps its value); sec:diagnostics "-3 for -3r" (a signed literal is a literal)
=2.5 => -2.5 -- L1.26b "f(x) = (x, 1) is (x: T) -> (T, 1)" (a literal returned keeps its value); sec:diagnostics "-3 for -3r" (a signed literal is a literal)
=2.5f64 => f64 !! LIT-forced-carrier: -2.5 -- sec:lexical "+ - * arithmetic on numbers"; sec:domains "three() = 1 + 2 is () -> int"
=2r => rat !! LIT-forced-carrier: -2r -- sec:lexical "+ - * arithmetic on numbers"; sec:domains "three() = 1 + 2 is () -> int"
=k => int -- sec:lexical "+ - * arithmetic on numbers"; sec:domains "three() = 1 + 2 is () -> int"

template: !$0
int => error * -- sec:lexical "! logical not"
rat => error * -- sec:lexical "! logical not"
f32 => error * -- sec:lexical "! logical not"
f64 => error * -- sec:lexical "! logical not"
f16 => error * !! L1.18a: notyet -- sec:lexical "! logical not"
bool => bool -- sec:lexical "! logical not"
Utf8String => error * !! STR-types: notyet -- sec:lexical "! logical not"
(int, f64) => error * -- sec:lexical "! logical not"
int | #none => error * -- sec:lexical "! logical not"
f64 | #none => error * -- sec:lexical "! logical not"
=#none => #none -- sec:failure "an atom an operand carries in passes through"; author decision "loose atoms bubble when the rest matches"
=2 => error * -- sec:lexical "! logical not"
=2.5 => error * -- sec:lexical "! logical not"
=2.5f64 => error * -- sec:lexical "! logical not"
=2r => error * -- sec:lexical "! logical not"
=k => error * -- sec:lexical "! logical not"
